profile.name: ESP32开发板
profile.description: ESP32开发板是一种基于ESP32芯片的嵌入式微控制器设备，通常通过串口与计算机连接。在实验室中可用于固件烧录、串口通信测试、嵌入式程序开发以及与外部传感器或控制电路的原型验证。
profile.description_en: An ESP32 development board is an embedded microcontroller device based on the ESP32 chip, typically connected to a computer over a serial interface. In laboratory settings, it is commonly used for firmware flashing, serial communication testing, embedded software development, and prototyping with external sensors or control circuits.
